startup_idea: An AI-powered personal finance assistant for young professionals that automatically analyzes bank transactions, tracks spending, creates personalized budgets, predicts upcoming expenses, and provides actionable financial recommendations through a mobile app.

idea_analysis.problem: Young professionals struggle to manage finances due to lack of automated insights and budgeting tools.
idea_analysis.proposed_solution: An AI-powered mobile app that analyzes bank transactions, tracks spending, creates budgets, predicts expenses, and offers actionable recommendations.
idea_analysis.business_model: Subscription-based freemium model with premium features

assumptions: Users are willing to pay for premium features
